observations: Seller claims they tested it yesterday, but provides no new photos/videos.
Photos provided earlier still show only PS4 packaging/box panels; no console, controller, games, ports, or receipt are visible.
No evidence is shown that contradicts or confirms the seller’s testing claim.

claims.evidence: No games or controller/pad are pictured in the provided photos.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working
claims.evidence: No powered-on test, port close-up, or video proof is provided; only packaging photos were shared.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No controller/pad or receipt is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: Seller tested it themselves yesterday; everything I said is true
claims.evidence: This is a text-only assertion with no new photo/video evidence.

risks.risk: The console may not be included, may be different from what’s claimed, or may not be working (disc drive/HDMI/ports).
risks.proof: Short video: power on to home screen + show at least one port in use (HDMI connected) + insert a disc and show it loads.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: not verifiably working PS4 bundle (discount heavily).

risks.risk: Games and controller may be missing, not the exact titles, or not included in the quantity claimed.
risks.proof: Photo/clip showing all 10 game discs/cases laid out and the controller/pad clearly visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: no games and no controller included (or only what is verifiably present).

risks.risk: Receipt/serial matching may be false or not match the console.
risks.proof: Photo of the UK receipt with readable details AND photo of the console serial/model label that matches.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: no valid receipt proof.

risks.risk: Overheating/repair history can’t be confirmed remotely without internal/thermal or service proof.
risks.proof: Video showing sustained operation (e.g., 10–15 minutes gameplay/menu) with no shutdowns + photo of vents/condition; optionally show system settings/health if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as worst case: treat as potentially repaired/unknown condition.

proof_requests: Send new photos (not just text): actual PS4 console front + back with model/serial label readable (CUH-xxxx).
Send photo of the controller/pad (front + back/ports) and confirm it pairs/charges.
Send photo of all included games (10 discs/cases) laid out clearly.
Send a short video: power on to home screen + insert one disc and show it loads.
Send photo of the UK receipt with readable details and ensure it matches the console serial/model.
response.reason: A text claim of testing doesn’t replace missing visual proof. Since the current photos still only show PS4 packaging, the worst-case value can’t be priced confidently without console/controller/games and a working test.
